caption: The drawing features a detailed illustration of a single heeled shoe positioned in profile view, occupying the upper portion of a rectangular frame. The shoe is predominantly light gray or white with subtle shading to indicate form, a gently curved heel, and a thin brown sole that outlines its base. The top edge of the shoe is decorated with a ruched or ruffled trim, and a decorative bow is attached on the upper part of the shoe’s vamp. Below the shoe, there are two line drawings presented horizontally, each showing the outline of the shoe's sole, including the heel area, with a small cutout or indentation illustrated near the back of each sole. The background is a plain, uncolored surface, and all elements are contained within a single rectangular border. The artist's signature is located in the lower right corner within the rectangle.
title: Woman's Shoe
